title: A Summer for the Songbook
author: Freya Thackeray
blurb: Beatrix Nystrom, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
